explanationMd: The square root is nonnegative, so x ≥ 0. Squaring gives 2x + 3 = x², or (x − 3)(x + 1) = 0. Only x = 3 is nonnegative, and √9 = 3 verifies it.

distractorRationale.a: This root of the squared equation has a negative right side and fails the original.
distractorRationale.c: The left side is √5 rather than one.
distractorRationale.e: The left side is √3 rather than zero.
